item.title: EPL: SuperComputer predicts title winners after Arsenal beat Brighton, City drop points
item.description: The Opta SuperComputer has updated its predictions on the Premier League title race following a dramatic day of fixtures on Wednesday. item.title: FUD expels 20 students over alleged examination misconduct
item.description: The Federal University Dutse, FUD, has expelled 20 students over examination malpractice during the Second Semester of the 2024/2025 Academic Session. This was contained in a statement signed by the University’s Director of Public Affairs, Alhaji Abdullahi Yahaya Bello, ANIPR, and made available to newsmen.
